sections.description:
NON-BANKING FINANCE COMPANIES AND NOTIFIED ENTITIES REGULATIONS, 2008
NON-BANKING FINANCE COMPANIES AND NOTIFIED ENTITIES REGULATIONS, 2008
(Amendment of Sched. XI)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part-II,
26th April, 2012]
S.R.O.
414(I)/2012 dated 26-4-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by
subsection (2) of section 282B of the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of
1984), the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan is pleased to make
the following further
amendments in Non-Banking Finance Companies and Notified
Entities Regulations, 2008, namely:--
In
Schedule XI of the aforesaid Regulations,--
(i) for the
number and word "90 days" appearing in the second column against
"Substandard" category, the number and word "180 days"
shall be substituted;
(ii) for the
number and word "180 days" appearing in the second column against
"Doubtful" category, the number and word "1 year" shall be
substituted; and
(iii) for
the number and word "1 year" appearing in the second column against
"Loss" category, the number and word "2 years" shall
substituted.
